note: Planned registry only. status planned means not yet implemented or run; no test is claimed passing. Tiers derive from the task manifest. Live-provider/host/backup gates are recorded separately and never satisfied by local fakes.

races.scenario: Two initial registrations/phone changes contend for one canonical phone.
Two publications contend for the last open slot or activation allowance.
Two identical intents published concurrently by one owner.
Two offer submissions contend for one seller/cycle slot or daily allowance.
Budget/category/material revision races with offer submission and resubmission.
Offer withdrawal or revision races with contact initiation.
Buyer closure/expiry/renewal races with offer or contact.
Account suspension/ban/deletion and category prohibition race with contact.
Blocking races with contact; unblocking never resurrects old offers.
Duplicate contact/outcome actions use the same idempotency identity concurrently.
Several distinct seller contacts contend for the final contact allowance.
Two workers claim the same expiry/prompt/retention job; one crashes after claim.
A retryable transaction failure cannot repeat an external provider request or duplicate a business event.
A phone change occurs before an old contact request is retried; current destination authoritative, history unchanged.
